name: dayflow
description: AI-powered task manager with end-to-end encryption
author: Tewodros Ashenafi

scripts.build:web: EXPO_PUBLIC_BUILD_ID=$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M) expo export --clear --platform web --output-dir web-build && node scripts/make-pwa.js web-build
scripts.build:pages: EXPO_PUBLIC_BUILD_ID=$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M) EXPO_BASE_URL=/Claude expo export --clear --platform web --output-dir web-build && node scripts/make-pwa.js web-build /Claude
scripts.test: node tests/crypto-and-merge.test.mjs && node tests/vault.test.mjs && node tests/error-report.test.mjs && node tests/sync-config.test.mjs && node tests/parser.test.mjs && node tests/ordering.test.mjs && node tests/alerts.test.mjs && node tests/projects.test.mjs && node tests/archive.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e/two-device-sync.mjs && node tests/e2e/voice-routing.mjs && node tests/e2e/delete-and-undo.mjs && node tests/e2e/add-sheet.mjs && node tests/e2e/reorder.mjs && node tests/e2e/task-time.mjs && node tests/e2e/scope-move.mjs && node tests/e2e/reminders.mjs && node tests/e2e/sound.mjs && node tests/e2e/reorder-buttons.mjs && node tests/e2e/projects.mjs && node tests/e2e/archive.mjs
